messages.snippet: Harbor Hall can hold the main room for us.
messages.textBody:
Hi Casey,

Harbor Hall can hold the main room for us on the 12th and 13th. They need a final head count before they sign the contract.

The floor plan is attached. The main room seats 30 at round tables.

Sarah

messages.snippet: Thanks. I am waiting on two teams.
messages.textBody:
Thanks, Sarah. I am waiting on two teams. I will send the number as soon as I have it.

Casey

messages.snippet: Can you confirm the head count by Friday?
messages.textBody:
Hi Casey,

Can you confirm the head count by Friday? The venue needs the number before they hold the room. If we miss Friday, the next open date is in April.

Also, do we need the projector in the second room?

Thanks,
Sarah
